title: TikTok KOL Supervisor
description:
Job Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated KOL Manager to oversee and grow our TikTok influencer marketing efforts in Philippines. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing relationships with TikTok influencers to drive brand awareness, engagement, and ultimately sales in the local market.

Key Responsibilities:

1. KOL Strategy Development:

  - Develop and implement a comprehensive TikTok KOL influencer strategy aligned with brand objectives, market trends, and consumer insights in Vietnam.

  - Create campaigns that drive engagement, brand awareness, and conversion, with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes.

2. KOL Research and Identification:

  - Identify and establish relationships with top-tier and micro-influencers in Vietnam who align with the brand’s values, target audience, and goals.

  - Stay up-to-date with TikTok trends and emerging influencers to ensure the brand is always at the forefront of the platform.

3. Campaign Execution & Management:

  - Oversee end-to-end influencer campaign execution, from briefing and content creation to final delivery and performance analysis.

  - Ensure influencers’ content aligns with brand guidelines, voice, and overall marketing strategy.

4. Collaboration and Negotiation:

  - Negotiate contracts, terms, and compensation with influencers and influencer agencies to ensure mutually beneficial partnerships.

  - Collaborate with internal teams (creative, PR, and marketing) to ensure influencer content is integrated seamlessly into the overall marketing strategy.

5. Performance Tracking and Reporting:

  - Monitor the performance of KOL campaigns on TikTok, track key metrics (engagement, reach, conversions), and optimize strategies accordingly.

  - Provide regular reports and insights to management on campaign effectiveness, ROI, and influencer impact.

6. Community Building:

  - Build and nurture long-term relationships with influencers to foster loyalty and repeat collaborations.

  - Engage in community management by interacting with influencers’ audiences and ensuring positive brand sentiment.

7. Market and Competitor Insights:

  - Monitor competitors' influencer strategies on TikTok and analyze trends in influencer marketing within Philippine’s digital landscape.

  - Use data and insights to continuously improve and adapt the influencer strategy.

Qualifications:

- Proven experience in influencer marketing or KOL management, ideally in the TikTok ecosystem, preferably within Philippines.

- Strong understanding of TikTok trends, features, and best practices.

- Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

- Creative mindset with an ability to think outside the box to create viral content.

- Fluent in English (both written and spoken).

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred:

- Experience working with a brand in the lifestyle, fashion, or e-commerce industry.

- Existing network of TikTok influencers in Philippines.

title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 3K USD/MO
description:
Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.



Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

What country and time zone are you located in?

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD?



How to Apply



DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH

YOU MUST submit the following to 
 portfolio.



Examples of creative briefs you have created.



Examples of ads you helped strategize.



A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process.



Answers to the application questions above.

title: Business Manager / Supervisor – Retail Channel (Philippines)
description:
Location: Metro Manila (covering key retail regions nationwide)



Benefits:

* Comprehensive medical benefits

* Travel & accommodation allowance

* Systematic product knowledge and management training at China Headquarters

* Competitive sales incentive policies with attractive commission schemes



Position Overview

We are seeking a dynamic Business Manager / Supervisor to lead and grow our Modern Trade and Retail channels across the Philippines. This role is pivotal in driving market share and brand penetration within the coatings and building materials retail sector. The successful candidate will manage key accounts, expand retail networks, and lead a high-performing team to achieve.



Job Key Responsibilities

* Lead the retail sales team to achieve revenue and collection targets nationwide.

* Develop and execute retail channel expansion strategies with major home improvement chains and supermarkets (SM Home, Robinsons, Wilcon, CW Home Depot, Ace Hardware).

* Act as Key Account Manager (KAM) for top retail groups (SM, Robinsons, Puregold, Mercury Drug), handling framework agreements, promotions, and display fee negotiations.

* Manage and evaluate local retail distributors to ensure broad coverage across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

* Collaborate with Marketing to execute in-store promotions, “Perfect Store” initiatives, and planogram standards.

* Coach and motivate frontline sales representatives and merchandisers; conduct regular business reviews.

* Travel frequently between Metro Manila and key cities (Cebu, Davao) and represent the company at exhibitions (e.g., WORLDBEX).

* Ensure compliance with local tax regulations (BIR) and commercial laws.



Job Qualifications



* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.

* 3–5 years of sales management experience in Philippine retail channels or Modern Trade.

* Strong preference for candidates with experience in leading building materials or coatings companies (Nippon Paint, Dulux, Jotun, Asian Paints, Sika).

* Proven track record in key account development or store roll-outs with major retailers (SM, Robinsons, Wilcon).

* Fluent in English and Tagalog; Mandarin proficiency is a plus.

* Excellent negotiation skills, resilience under pressure, and a results-driven mindset.

* Strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills.

* Willingness to travel extensively; must have own transportation for store audits in Metro Manila.



Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of a fast-growing retail channel, gain international training exposure, and enjoy competitive incentives while working with a leading brand in the building materials industry.

title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
description:
Enablement Team  •  Reports to Business Solutions Specialist



POSITION SUMMARY

The Software Engineer is responsible for the development, support, and continuous improvement of the organization's internally developed business applications. This role partners closely with Product Engineering, Software Engineering, and the Director of Enablement to develop and maintain key proprietary applications across every stage, from early concept through full implementation.

The position serves as the primary engineering resource for applications developed on the Replit platform while leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor, to rapidly build, maintain, and improve internal software solutions.

This is a dynamic, fast-moving role suited to someone who is comfortable operating with a high degree of self-management and creative problem-solving. The person in this role will work in close, continuous feedback loops with users and leadership, will meet multiple times per week to discuss product direction and strategy, and will be expected to move quickly without sacrificing the quality of what ships. Strong written and verbal communication is essential: this person must be able to distill technical ideas and solutions into plain, clear language that non-technical stakeholders can readily understand.



WORKING STYLE & EXPECTATIONS

● Operates with a high degree of autonomy and self-management across a fast-changing, evolving set of priorities.

● Brings creative, resourceful problem-solving to ambiguous or open-ended requests.

● Comfortable receiving continuous, ongoing feedback from users and organizational leadership, and iterating quickly in response.

● Able to sustain a fast pace of delivery while maintaining a high bar for quality and impact.

● Participates in multiple meetings per week with product and leadership stakeholders to align on strategy and prioritization for proprietary applications.

● Translates technical concepts, tradeoffs, and solutions into plain language that non-technical users and leadership can easily understand.



TYPICAL DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW

This role follows an established, feedback-driven development cycle designed to move quickly from idea to working software:

● Ideas, feedback, and enhancement requests are captured as issues in Linear.

● Linear issues feed directly into the development environment — primarily Replit, with Cursor used as needed.

● Agentic coding tools are used to stand up new applications and iterations quickly, without compromising quality.

● Completed work closes the loop back in Linear, and the requesting user is notified of what was implemented and how it addresses their original feedback.

● Throughout the cycle, updates and outcomes are communicated in plain, non-technical language so stakeholders always understand progress and impact.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Application Development

● Develop, maintain, and enhance internally developed business applications utilizing Replit as the primary development platform.

● Leverage AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor, to accelerate feature delivery while maintaining code quality.

● Implement new functionality based on stakeholder feedback and business priorities.

● Refactor existing applications for scalability, maintainability, security, and performance.

● Participate in technical design and solution architecture for new applications.



Application Support

● Troubleshoot production issues and resolve application defects.

● Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent solutions.

● Coordinate application releases and production deployments.

● Monitor application health and proactively reduce technical debt.



Continuous Improvement

● Maintain a prioritized backlog of enhancements and feature requests.

● Collaborate with business stakeholders to continuously improve usability and adoption.

● Deliver iterative improvements that solve operational challenges.



Systems Integration & Automation

● Develop and maintain integrations with TMS, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Entra, Slack, ZoomInfo, CRM platforms, and other enterprise systems.

● Build and support API integrations, workflow automations, meeting automations, and RPA solutions.

● Monitor and maintain synchronization between business systems.

AI Engineering & Development Acceleration

● Utilize Replit AI, Cursor, and modern AI engineering workflows to accelerate software development.

● Evaluate emerging AI-assisted engineering capabilities and establish development best practices.

● Promote secure, maintainable, and scalable AI-assisted software engineering practices.



Quality Assurance & Documentation

● Perform testing and support UAT prior to deployment.

● Maintain technical documentation, deployment documentation, and release history.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

● Experience developing business applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web technologies.

● Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

● Experience integrating REST APIs and SaaS platforms.

● Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and analytical skills.

● Ability to independently manage production applications and enhancements.

● Ability to manage own workload and priorities in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment.

● Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical work into plain language for non-technical users and leadership.

● Comfortable working within a tool such as Linear to track feedback, issues, and delivery status.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:



● Highly preferred: Experience developing on the Replit platform.

● Highly preferred: Experience with prompt engineering and agentic coding workflows.

●Experience with prompt engineering and agentic coding workflows.Experience designing workflow automation and robotic process automation solutions.

● Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Slack, Microsoft Entra, ZoomInfo, CRM platforms, and logistics technology ecosystems.



SUCCESS MEASURES

● Reliable operation of internal applications.

● Timely delivery of enhancements and bug fixes.

● High user adoption and satisfaction.

● Reduced manual effort through automation.

● Secure, scalable, and well-documented business applications.

Reports To: Head of Engineering

title: Fractional Operator (COO / CMO / OBM) to Help Launch a New EdTech Startup
description:
Hi! I am a physician and a 15+ year entrepreneur, and I am launching a new education and tutoring app. This role is for that new venture. I am looking for a fractional operator to be my right hand as I get it off the ground. Call it a Fractional COO, a Fractional CMO, or an Online Business Manager. What I need is one strategic, execution-obsessed person who can take my ideas and turn them into real traction. I am strongest at vision and at building the product. I am hiring for everything that comes after.



A LITTLE ABOUT ME

I have already built and run a profitable online education business that has helped more than 10,000 professionals pass a high-stakes exam. I mention that only so you know I have built a real, successful company before. I am happy to share the details once we are talking. This new app is a separate, early-stage venture, and it is what you would help me launch and grow.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS ABOUT

An idea is worth nothing until it is executed, and a product only becomes a business when someone owns the marketing, the operations, and the hundred little things in between. This new app needs traction, and I need someone who can own that side alongside me from the ground up, so it becomes a real business instead of a great idea that stalls.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Getting the venture off the ground: set up the accounts, handles, tools, and systems a new company needs, and build the foundation from zero.

Marketing leadership: own or direct marketing across social media, SEO, paid ads,
, community outreach, and content. This is both strategy and execution, either done by you or directed through others.

Operations and project management: turn ideas into clear plans, coordinate contractors, agencies, and AI agents, keep everything moving, and be the accountability layer that makes sure things actually get done.

Delegation and follow-through: you will not do all of this yourself. You will delegate to AI agents and human contractors, then follow up to make sure the work lands.



HOW WE WORK

You will work closely with me (the founder) and a set of AI agents that already handle a lot of the execution. Comfort with, or genuine curiosity about, working alongside AI tools is a big plus. It means you will get far more done here than in a typical role.



CORE VALUES

I care more about how you work than how flashy your resume looks. My best team members lead with humility, take ownership, and always act in service of the mission.

NO DRAMA: humble, flexible, team player, coachable

ALTRUISM: selfless, compassionate, radically honest

INITIATIVE: growth mindset, proactive, innovative

INTELLIGENCE: strategic thinker, articulate, detail-oriented

EXCELLENCE: hardworking, dependable, consistent, high integrity



YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT IF

You have operated as a Fractional COO, Fractional CMO, OBM, or something similar (you have run the operations and/or marketing of a business, not just tasks within one).

You can think strategically and still roll up your sleeves to execute.

You are a strong predictor of workload and competing priorities, and you hit your deadlines.

You have taken projects from initial idea all the way to full execution, including coordinating and delegating to others.

You have real marketing ability (social,
, paid ads, SEO) and can recognize sharp, clean copy that shifts beliefs.

You are self-driven, emotionally intelligent, and take initiative.

You welcome accountability and can deliver without micromanagement.

You are genuinely excited by early-stage startups where you build from zero.



YOU WILL NOT BE A GOOD FIT IF

You only want to do strategy and hand off all the doing, or only want to do tasks without thinking strategically.

You need constant direction.

You are juggling many other clients or projects.

You are uncomfortable giving and receiving honest feedback.

You shut down when held accountable to agreed tasks and timelines.

You want to stay surface-level instead of going deep.



LOGISTICS

Remote, part-time and fractional to start, with room to grow as the venture gains traction.

Significant daily overlap with the founder's US working hours (exact overlap discussed during the interview).

Compensation is competitive and based on experience.



FINAL NOTE

This is a chance to help build something new from the very beginning, alongside a founder who has already built a business that changes lives. If you are the kind of operator who turns ideas into reality and takes ownership of your craft, I would love to meet you.



Looking forward to meeting you.

title: AI Static Ads Operator
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $300 – $400 USD/month depending on speed and consistency, plus a bonus every time one of your statics becomes a winner we scale.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your portfolio — that is where we want them. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run e-commerce brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Winning ads are not invented, they are rebuilt. Our system is already built and documented. We need one person to run it, every day, with Claude.



Your target is 50 finished static ads per day. That number sounds high until you see the process — you are not designing from a blank page. You are taking an ad that already works and rebuilding it for our product.



Your daily work



1. Find what is already winning. Open the ad libraries, find the ads that have been running for months. A long-running ad is a profitable ad. Save them to our swipe library.



2. Rebuild them for our products. Write the image prompt in Claude, generate the image. Same composition, same framing, same energy as the original — only the product, the text and the numbers change. You are not being creative. You are being accurate.



3. Regenerate until it matches. The first output is never right. You look at what is off, you fix the prompt, you go again.



4. Always 1080 × 1080. Every single one, even when the original ad is vertical. You check the exported size before you deliver. This is not open to interpretation.



5. Send the batch every day. You get revision notes back. You apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log every image — unique name, archived, with the prompt that made it. We must be able to relaunch any winner months later without regenerating it.



What we need from you

Written English that a native speaker would not flag. You write the prompts and the text that goes on the images. This is the first filter, before anything else.

You have used AI image tools. Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Firefly — any of them. You already know the first output is rarely good.

You can match a layout. Canva, Photoshop or Figma — place text cleanly, match a font, export exact dimensions.

You follow a written process exactly. "Always 1080 × 1080" means always.

You are extremely organised. File names, folders, registries. If you cannot find an image from three weeks ago in ten seconds, this is not for you.

You tell us when you are blocked instead of going quiet.

You can handle volume without dropping quality. This is repetitive work. The person who thrives here is the person who likes a rhythm, not the person who needs a new challenge every week.

Nice to have



 Ads Manager. Claude Code. Any direct response marketing background — we will train you on our system.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

The system already exists. You are not inventing anything, you are running a machine. Everything is documented.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager, no meetings.

Paid trial first: one reference ad rebuilt for one of our products, 1080 × 1080, three text variations. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.



Again: the only way to apply is

title: Graphic designer/ ads designer
description:
Dear future creative partner!



We are looking for a Virtual Assistant / Social Media Designer who really understands advertising.



Not just someone who knows how to use Canva, Photoshop or AI.



We are looking for someone who understands how an advertisement should look, feel and communicate to a Dutch and European audience.



That distinction is very important to us.



A design that might work in the Philippines, India or another market does not automatically work in the Netherlands.



Dutch advertising is often cleaner, more direct and more subtle. Typography, spacing, colors, photography and the amount of information on the screen all matter.



We need someone who understands that.



You need to be able to look at an advertisement and understand:



* What should grab attention first?

* What message needs to be understood within seconds?

* Which words should stand out?

* How do you use text without destroying the design?

* How do you make an advertisement feel native to the Dutch market?

* How do you make someone stop scrolling without making the design look cheap?



If this already sounds familiar to you, keep reading.



What we are looking for:



* Experience creating social media advertisements

* A strong understanding of advertising for Dutch or European audiences

* Very good understanding of typography, hierarchy, spacing and composition

* You know how to use text inside a design without making it look crowded

* You understand how to visually communicate one clear message

* You have a strong feeling for color combinations

* You can take a marketing concept and turn it into a visual that actually makes sense

* You understand that a good ad is not necessarily the prettiest ad

* You know how to create visual hooks that make people stop scrolling

* You follow social media, advertising formats, trends, memes and new creative concepts

* You can work with Canva, Photoshop, Figma or similar design tools

* You are comfortable experimenting with AI, but you don't depend on it

* You can recognize when an AI-generated image looks fake or unnatural

* You are confident enough to challenge an idea if you think the design can be better

* You communicate clearly and can work independently



Experience with Meta Ads, performance marketing or recruitment marketing is a big plus.



And yes, having a slight social media addiction is actually useful for this job. ????



A little more about Social Techniek Vacatures:



Social Techniek Vacatures helps technical companies in the Netherlands find new employees through social media.



We create recruitment campaigns for companies looking for mechanics, technicians, engineers, work planners and other technical professionals.



Instead of waiting for candidates to search through job boards, we put our clients directly in front of the right people through platforms such as
 and Instagram.



Our team currently consists of:



* A Social Media Manager

* A Systems Manager

* A Recruiter

* A Marketing Manager



You will work mostly with our Marketing Manager.



He has been running advertising campaigns on Meta for more than 10 years and loves experimenting with creative advertising concepts.



That is also why this isn't a normal design job.



We don't want stiff corporate recruitment advertisements.



And we definitely don't want the same template with:



Stock photo.

Big headline.

Three icons.

Company logo.

Done.



We want to create advertisements that people actually notice.



Sometimes that's a very clean advertisement.



Sometimes it's a WhatsApp conversation.



Sometimes it's a handwritten note attached to a computer.



Sometimes it's a meme.



Sometimes it's a timer inside a work van.



Sometimes it's something completely different.



The concept always comes first.



Your job is to help us turn that concept into something that looks believable, professional and visually strong.



A big part of the job is working with text inside advertisements.



We create ads where the copy itself is often part of the visual concept.



That means you need to understand how to highlight certain words, create hierarchy and guide someone's eyes through the advertisement.



The message needs to be immediately understandable without making the design look like a flyer full of text.



This is very important to us.



Things we do NOT want:



* Generic Canva templates

* Designs that look like cheap recruitment advertisements

* Random fonts combined without a reason

* Poor spacing or alignment

* Colors that don't work together

* Too many visual elements fighting for attention

* Designs created without thinking about the target audience

* AI-generated images where you can immediately see that they are AI

* Fake-looking people, hands, tools, workplaces or environments

* Designs that look good technically but don't communicate anything

* Someone who simply copies our reference without understanding why it works



We use AI ourselves and we love it.



But AI should make the work better.



It should never be an excuse for bad design.



What you will mainly be doing:



* Creating Meta ad creatives for
 and Instagram

* Turning our advertising concepts into finished designs

* Creating multiple variations of strong concepts

* Integrating headlines, subtitles and other copy into visuals

* Improving existing advertisements

* Creating new visual hooks

* Adapting creatives for different vacancies and clients

* Thinking along with us about new concepts

* Keeping an eye on advertising and social media trends

* Using AI when it genuinely improves the creative



You don't need to invent every campaign from scratch.



A lot of concepts will come from us.



But we don't want an order taker.



We want a creative sparring partner.



Someone who receives an idea from us and thinks:



“I get what you're trying to do. But I think it will be even stronger if we do it like this.”



That's the person we're looking for.



Before you apply:



Please don't send us a generic portfolio with logos, restaurant menus, flyers and presentation designs.



We specifically want to see social media advertisements.



Preferably advertisements created for companies or audiences in the Netherlands or Europe.



Send us 3 to 5 advertisements that you personally designed and that you believe show your best advertising work.



Also briefly explain which one of those advertisements you think is the strongest and why.



We are especially interested in how you think about:



* Attention

* Typography

* Message hierarchy

* Target audience

* Conversion



If you have read everything, start your application with the word “Scrollstopper”.



Applications without relevant advertising examples will not be considered.



Think you understand the kind of creative work we're looking for?



Then we'd love to see what you can do.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Are you someone who is a great communicator, highly organized, and enjoys helping clients? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and know how to stay on top of multiple conversations at once? If so, we’d love to have you join our team!



About Us:



We’re a growing real estate photography business that prides itself on providing high-quality service and a great experience for our clients. We believe in working hard, having fun, and supporting each other along the way. We’re looking for a Virtual Assistant who can help keep communication running smoothly between our clients and our team.

Client Communication: Respond to client messages, questions, scheduling requests, changes, and other needs throughout your shift.



Internal Communication: Communicate with our photographers, editors, and other team members to make sure everyone has the information they need.



Scheduling & Coordination: Help coordinate appointments, schedule changes, and updates between clients and our team.



Client Support: Help resolve client questions and requests quickly and professionally, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



General Support: Assist with other communication or administrative tasks as needed.

Availability Monday–Thursday, 2:00 PM–6:00 PM Eastern Time: You must be consistently available during these hours.



Excellent English & Communication Skills: You’ll be communicating directly with our clients, so strong written and spoken English is extremely important.



Friendly & Professional: We want our clients to always feel that they are receiving helpful, attentive service.



Reliable & Responsive: We need someone we can count on to be online, available, and responsive throughout their shift.



Organized & Detail-Oriented: You should be able to manage multiple conversations and requests without letting things get missed.



Problem Solver: We’re looking for someone who can think independently, use good judgment, and figure things out when unexpected situations come up.



Flexibility & Adaptability: Every day can look a little different, so you should be comfortable adjusting as things come up.



Why You’ll Love Working With Us:



Supportive Team: We work together and will provide the training and tools you need to succeed.



Room to Grow: As our business continues to expand, there may be opportunities to take on additional hours, responsibilities, and grow with the company.



If You’re Interested:



Please send us:



* Your resume

* A screenshot of your internet speed test

* A short video introducing yourself

* Confirmation that you are available **Monday–Thursday from 2:00 PM–6:00 PM Eastern Time**



We’ll reach out to selected candidates with the next steps!

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a Junior Video Editor to join our team and help us increase our video production capacity.



This is a great opportunity for an editor with basic editing skills who wants to gain more experience working on YouTube content and grow into a more advanced editing role over time.



You will mainly work with ready-made footage, scripts, references, and instructions. You won’t be expected to create complex animations or highly advanced edits from scratch.



Here is an example of the general editing quality and style we are looking for:


/file/d/1CV8zbmOEKrqt6sfAvJnTtcNK5QU0Otjl/view



The videos you will work on may be in a different niche and won’t necessarily require exactly the same level of editing. This reference is mainly intended to show the general quality, pacing, and editing approach we’re aiming for.



What you’ll do



* Edit videos according to provided scripts, references, and instructions

* Cut and arrange footage into a coherent video

* Add basic transitions, text, images, B-roll, music, and sound effects

* Make simple adjustments to audio and color

* Follow an established editing style and workflow

* Make revisions based on feedback

* Organize project files and assets

* Deliver videos on time and communicate if there are any issues



Requirements



* Basic video editing experience

* Comfortable working in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar software

* Understanding of basic cuts, pacing, transitions, audio, and text

* Ability to follow instructions and work from a reference

* Good attention to detail

* Reliable and able to meet deadlines

* Willingness to learn and improve



You don’t need to be an advanced editor. We are more interested in someone who has a solid foundation, is reliable, and can consistently produce clean, watchable edits.



Nice to have



* Experience editing YouTube videos

* Basic understanding of B-roll and storytelling

* Basic knowledge of sound design and color correction

* Experience with documentary, educational, commentary, or similar content



Compensation



$0.50–$1 per finished minute



The position is part-time, with the possibility of increasing the workload and moving to full-time in the future for strong performers.



This role is initially intended to support our existing editing team and provide additional editing capacity as we scale.

title: Creator Affiliate Outreach & Recruitment Freelancer
description:
We’re looking for a highly proactive Creator Affiliate Outreach & Recruitment Freelancer to build and manage a large network of UK-based creators who can promote our e-commerce clothing brand on a performance basis.



This is not primarily an influencer marketing or brand awareness role.



Your job is to find creators, contact them, get them interested, onboard them and turn them into active affiliates who generate sales.



We want someone who is comfortable doing high-volume outreach every single day and relentlessly following up.



What You’ll Be Doing

Research and identify relevant UK creators across:

TikTok

Instagram

YouTube


Build large prospect lists of potential affiliates

Personally contact creators via DM,
 and other appropriate channels

Explain our affiliate proposition clearly and persuasively

Recruit creators onto our affiliate programme

Arrange product/sample gifting where appropriate

Provide creators with their affiliate link/code and promotional information

Follow up repeatedly with creators who have not responded

Encourage recruited creators to actually publish content

Reactivate creators who join but do not post

Identify creators already producing content that suits our customer demographic

Track outreach, replies, sign-ups, content posted and sales generated

Continually test different outreach messages and approaches to improve response rates

Who We Want



We want someone who is extremely good at outreach.



You should be:



Persistent without being spammy

Comfortable sending hundreds of targeted outreach messages

Highly organised

Good at finding creators others might overlook

Excellent at writing short, persuasive DMs and
s

Commercially minded

Focused on sales rather than vanity metrics

Comfortable being measured against clear KPIs



Previous experience recruiting influencers, creators, affiliates or UGC creators is strongly preferred.



Experience with UK e-commerce or fashion is a major advantage.



Creator Profile



Our core audience is predominantly UK men aged approximately 35–55.



Potential creator categories include:



Men's lifestyle

Dad / family creators

Men's fashion

Tradesmen

Builders / electricians / plumbers

Golf

Gym / fitness

Cars / motoring

DIY

Workwear

Comedy

Everyday UK lifestyle

Deal / bargain creators



We are not only interested in large influencers.



Creators with smaller but engaged audiences can be extremely valuable.



We would rather recruit 100 commercially useful micro-creators than spend the entire budget chasing one celebrity influencer.



Affiliate Offer



Creators can earn:



£7 commission for every completed sale they generate.



There is no realistic ceiling on what a successful creator can earn.



Our preference is to build a large network of creators where both the creator and our business benefit directly from sales generated.



The Numbers Matter



This role will be judged primarily on:



Creators contacted

Response rate

Creators recruited

Creators activated

Content published

Affiliate sales generated

Cost per recruited active creator



An example weekly target could be:



250+ relevant creators contacted

50+ meaningful conversations

15–25 creators onboarded

10+ creators publishing content



We want someone who will eventually increase these numbers significantly as the system improves.



Important



Please do not apply if your strategy is simply:



"Find 20 influencers and send them an
."



We want someone capable of building a genuine creator acquisition machine.



Research → Outreach → Follow-up → Recruit → Activate → Track → Repeat.



Volume, persistence and quality all matter.



Hours & Budget



Initially approximately:



10–15 hours per week



Budget:



$500–$700 USD per month



There is scope to increase both the hours and budget substantially if the channel begins generating profitable sales.



We are also open to introducing performance bonuses based on recruited affiliate sales.



When Applying



Please answer the following:



Tell us about a creator/influencer/affiliate recruitment campaign you have previously worked on.

Approximately how many creators could you realistically contact each week?

How would you find UK micro-creators relevant to our demographic?

What outreach channels would you use?

Give us an example of the first DM you would send a creator.

How would you track prospects, follow-ups and recruited creators?

What would you aim to achieve during your first 30 days?



Please start your application with the words CREATOR OUTREACH so we know you have read the full brief.

Overview: We are seeking a highly creative and results-driven Social Media Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for social media, a strong understanding of the latest trends, and the ability to engage our audience with compelling content.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Content Creation:

- Develop, create, and manage content (text, images, video) tailored to each social media platform.

- Design and execute a content calendar to ensure a consistent posting schedule.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to align social media content with broader marketing strategies.

- Social Media Strategy:

- Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy to increase brand awareness, engagement, and follower growth.

- Analyze and report on social media performance metrics, making data-driven decisions to optimize strategies.

- Stay up-to-date with the latest social media trends, tools, and best practices.

3. Community Engagement:

- Engage with followers, respond to comments and messages in a timely manner, and manage online communities.

- Monitor and participate in relevant social media discussions about our brand and industry.

4. Campaign Management:

- Plan and execute social media advertising campaigns to support marketing objectives.

- Collaborate with influencers and brand ambassadors to amplify reach and engagement.

- Manage social media budget and optimize ad spend for maximum ROI.

5. Brand Management:

- Ensure brand consistency across all social media channels.

- Develop and enforce social media guidelines and best practices.

- Monitor and protect the brand’s online reputation.

6. Analytics and Reporting:

title: Virtual Assistant - Customer Service & Admin (Fluent in English Required)

Job Title: Remote Customer Support Assistant 
-Based)

s.



This is a straightforward, process-driven role. You will be given clear templates and step-by-step instructions for every situation – so you don't need any prior experience in e-commerce or customer service.



What we need more than anything is someone who is truly fluent in English – both in understanding and in writing. You must be able to write clearly, professionally, and with correct grammar and punctuation. This is the most important quality we are looking for.



We also need someone who:



Types quickly and accurately

Respond to customer queries via
 in a friendly, professional manner



Handle complaints and de-escalate issues calmly and politely



Help customers track their orders or check delivery status



Raise lost parcel claims with our courier (simple form-filling)



Log all queries in a tracking sheet to ensure nothing is missed



Flag any unresolved or complex issues to the team



Ensure no customer query is left unanswered beyond 24 hours



Availability & Working Hours

We offer complete flexibility – as long as you deliver results.



Your working hours are flexible, provided you:



Hit the required messages-per-hour target (we will agree this during training based on your speed)



Reply to all customers within the 24-hour SLA – no message should ever go unanswered beyond this



This means:



You can choose when to work each day – morning, afternoon, or evening



You can split your hours across the day if you prefer



As long as you clear all messages and meet the response time target, you have full control over your schedule



The only requirement is that you are available 7 days a week – but even then, your 2–3 hours can be at whatever time suits you best.



Training & Onboarding

We don't expect you to know everything on day one. Here is how your first week will work:



Week 1 – Training (paid):



You will join a Zoom call where we will walk you through:



How to reply to customers professionally



How to use our
 templates



How to navigate the customer messaging system



Once trained, you will start replying to real customer queries – but under supervision



We will review your replies together, guide you, and pick up on any mistakes



We will also make sure you are replying quickly enough to meet our 24-hour SLA



This supervised period ensures you feel confident and we maintain quality



After the first week, you will work more independently, but we will always be available for questions and support.



Long-Term Opportunity

This role is not a short-term gig – we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



As you become more competent and comfortable in the role, we will:



Offer you more hours



Give you additional responsibilities



Increase your pay as your role expands



If you are reliable, take ownership of your work, and show initiative, there is real room to progress with us.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

English fluency: You must be truly fluent in written English – perfect grammar, punctuation, and professional tone. This will be tested.



Typing speed: 50+ WPM (this will be tested live during your interview)



Equipment: Two screens and a fast, reliable computer with stable internet connection



Availability: 2–3 hours daily, 7 days a week – hours are flexible as long as you meet message targets and reply within 24 hours



Organisation: Able to log and track which queries are resolved and which are still open



Commitment: Looking for a long-term role, not just temporary work



Nice to Have (Not Required)

Previous experience in
-based customer service



Experience with raising courier claims



Familiarity with Google Sheets or Trello for task tracking



Experience working remotely



What We Offer

Consistent, ongoing part-time work with a clear path to more hours



Complete flexibility – work when it suits you, as long as targets are met



Full training provided – no guesswork



Clear templates and processes to make your job easy



Direct communication with the team – no layers of management



A long-term role with room to grow and earn more



Interview & Selection Process

Our selection process is designed to find the best person for the role. Here is how it works:



Step 1 – Initial Application



Send us a message with all the information requested below.



Step 2 – Written English Test



Shortlisted candidates will be sent a short written test. We will give you sample customer
s and ask you to reply to them. This tests your grammar, punctuation, tone, and ability to handle different customer situations.



Step 3 – Zoom Interview with Live Typing Test



Candidates who pass the written test will be invited to a Zoom interview. During this interview, we will:



Get to know you and ask a few questions about your experience and availability



Watch you complete a live typing test – we will share our screen with a typing test website and ask you to type for 2–3 minutes while we watch



This allows us to verify your typing speed in real-time and see how you perform under observation



The interview also gives you a chance to ask us any questions about the role



Step 4 – Final Decision



We will make a decision within 48 hours of the interview.



How to Apply

Please read carefully – incomplete applications will not be considered.



To apply, send us a message with all of the following information:



Your current typing speed (and when you last tested it)



Why you are suitable for this role – tell us about your English skills, organisation, attention to detail, and any experience you have with written communication



Your daily availability – confirm you are available 7 days a week and tell us roughly when you would typically work each day



Confirm you have two screens and a fast, reliable computer with stable internet



Confirm you are looking for a long-term role



Important Note

Please only apply if you are genuinely available 7 days a week, for 2–3 hours each day, and are looking for a long-term opportunity. Reliability and English fluency are the most important qualities we are looking for.

**Pest control industry experience is REQUIRED.** This is not an entry-level customer service position. We are looking for someone who already understands pest control operations, customer expectations, service scheduling, and the day-to-day workflow of a pest control business.



You will be responsible for communicating with customers, scheduling and coordinating services, handling service requests, updating customer accounts, and supporting the daily operations of the pest control team.



The ideal candidate is **professional, reliable, highly organized, confident on the phone, and comfortable working independently with US customers.**



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Handle complaints, cancellations, rescheduling requests, and service issues

* Follow up with customers regarding service requests and unresolved concerns

* Schedule pest control appointments and recurring services

* Help minimize scheduling conflicts and missed appointments

* Follow up on incomplete or missed services when necessary



### Customer Accounts & CRM



* Create and update customer accounts accurately

### Billing & Administrative Support

* Assist with customer retention and cancellation prevention

* Perform general administrative tasks related to customer service and operations

title: Virtual Assistant - Travel Concierge
description:
We're looking for a **Travel Concierge** who is passionate about crafting seamless travel experiences and delivering high-quality client service. You will be the trusted expert behind every journey, using AI-powered tools to research and recommend hotels, coordinating logistics across platforms, and communicating directly with travelers via WhatsApp to make every trip feel effortless and personal.



This role is for someone who loves travel, writes with warmth and clarity, thinks fast when plans change, and takes pride in the kind of attention to detail that makes clients feel like VIPs from the first message through check-in.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US Eastern Time business hours**

- Work in the luxury travel and hospitality space with access to premium brands and destinations

- Use cutting-edge AI tools to enhance research and elevate the client experience



## What You'll Work On



**Client Engagement and Support**



- Chat with travelers via WhatsApp to understand their preferences and deliver personalized recommendations

- Respond quickly and thoughtfully to incoming inquiries with initial responses landing within 10 to 20 minutes during your shift

- Handle special requests and ensure smooth communication between clients and hotels or vendors

- Maintain a calm, professional, and reassuring tone even when plans change at the last minute



**Research and Booking**



- Research and recommend hotels, restaurants, and attractions using AI tools and reliable online sources

- Verify every detail including location, timing, currency, and amenities before confirming bookings

- Coordinate hotel reservations, car rentals, and travel logistics across multiple booking platforms



**Content and Destination Curation**



- Write and curate destination guides and travel recommendations that blend editorial polish with practical, on-the-ground insight

- Collaborate with the marketing team to highlight exceptional hotels and destinations for social content

- Stay current on travel trends, new openings, and hidden gems worth knowing about



**Problem-Solving and Adaptability**



- Think fast and find creative solutions when plans shift due to flight delays, cancellations, or unexpected changes

- Communicate clearly and calmly under pressure to maintain client confidence and satisfaction



## What You Bring



- Empathetic and client-obsessed: you treat every traveler like a VIP

- Detail-oriented and reliable: you catch mistakes others miss before they become problems

- Exceptional written English: you write with clarity, warmth, and professionalism

- A self-starter: you love learning, exploring, and improving processes without being asked

- Tech-savvy: comfortable using Slack, WhatsApp, Google Sheets and Docs, and booking platforms

- Fast but thoughtful: you balance responsiveness with high-quality work

- Curious and well-informed: you research effectively, verify information, and stay ahead of travel trends



## Nice to Have



- Background in hospitality, travel, or concierge services

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT or travel research assistants

- Familiarity with airlines, loyalty programs, and travel booking systems

- International travel experience or strong knowledge of major global destinations

- Negotiation skills to advocate for clients with vendors and hotels



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume** highlighting any customer service or travel-related experience

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself and sharing why you are passionate about travel and client service





**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you love connecting with people, solving travel challenges, and creating experiences that feel effortless for the traveler, this role gives you the platform and the tools to do that every single day.

Job description:



Systems Administrator, Server & Infrastructure (Remote)

Tech Guru - IT for Accounting Firms

Why This Role Exists



At Tech Guru, we empower accounting firms with secure, high-performance IT that just works. As our Server & Infrastructure Systems Administrator, your mission is to own the reliability and security of the server, virtualization, and identity layers across our clients, all while living our core values of Caring, Accountable, Responsive, and Empathetic service.This is the deep-infrastructure seat.



You live in Windows Server, Hyper-V, RDS/AVD, Active Directory, and Entra ID, and you make sure the foundation everything else sits on never wobbles.



What Success Looks Like (Outcomes)



Near-Zero Server Downtime: Reduce critical server-side i
 for assigned clients to under 1 per quarter through proactive monitoring, scripting, and remediation.

Patch & Backup Assurance: Keep server patch compliance above 95 percent, verify backup success daily, and prove recoverability with tested restores and documented DR runbooks.

Healthy Virtualization Estate: Keep Hyper-V hosts and RDS/AVD session environments tuned, capacity-planned, and free of resource contention.

Hardened Foundation: Secure the server, Active Directory, and Entra layers to SOC 2 and FTC Safeguards expectations, with least-privilege and clean audit evidence.

Build Standardization: Design, document, and maintain gold images and deployment pipelines so server and session-host builds are repeatable and consistent.

Process Mastery: Create or update at least two Core Process documents each quarter, each simpler than its predecessor.

Day-to-day Responsibilities



Build, patch, monitor, and remediate Windows Server (2019, 2022, 2025) and Hyper-V hosts.

Administer Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and file/print roles.

Stand up, tune, and troubleshoot RDS and Azure Virtual Desktop session farms (connection brokers, session hosts, profile management).

Own server backup and disaster recovery (Ninjaone backup), including periodic restore testing.

Design and maintain gold images and automated deployment strategy for server and session-host environments.

Manage Dell server hardware lifecycle: firmware, iDRAC, RAID, and warranty/health.

Resolve SQL connectivity and named-instance issues for accounting application stacks.

Investigate complex server-side escalations and coach frontline techs on prevention.

Generate concise, client-ready server health reports that feed quarterly business reviews.

Core Values in Action



Caring: You treat every server estate as if it were your own.

Accountable: You own uptime outcomes, celebrate wins, and learn fast from misses.

Responsive: You communicate early and often, never leaving teammates or clients guessing.

Empathetic: You remember that behind every host is a firm trying to serve its clients.

Must-have Qualifications



5+ years administering Windows Server in an MSP or similar high-volume environment.

Hyper-V management including command-line and PowerShell scripting.

Strong Active Directory and Entra ID administration: GPO, DNS, DHCP, certificates.

Proven PowerShell skills for build automation, patching, and reporting.

Hands-on RDS, terminal server, or AVD session-host experience.

Backup and DR experience with at least one of Datto, Cove, or equivalent.

Excellent spoken and written English, comfortable supporting US-based clients.

Nice to Have



Dell server and iDRAC experience, including troubleshooting via CLI.

SQL Server administration and connectivity troubleshooting.

Experience supporting accounting or other compliance-heavy industries.

Certifications such as AZ-104, MCSA/MCSE, or CompTIA Security+.

What We Offer



Fully remote.

Professional development and paid training.

Flexible schedule built on trust and outcomes, not timeclock punching.

A caring, values-driven culture that celebrates wins and supports life outside work.

Our DEI Pledge

Tech Guru is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every tea
mber feels valued and empowered to contribute. We welcome applicants of any race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, socioeconomic background, disability status, or veteran status. If you share our passion for great IT and great people, we encourage you to apply, even if your resume does not tick every box



How to Apply

Upload your resume and a short cover letter on Indeed describing one measurable result you achieved by automating or standardizing a server or virtualization process.



Benefits:





Promotion to permanent employee

Work from home

Application Question(s):





What's your salary expectation?

Do you have a notice period?

Experience:





Windows Server : 5 years (Required)

Hyper V : 3 years (Required)

Active Directory: 3 years (Required)

PowerShell: 2 years (Required)

Server Backup (Ninjaone Backup): 2 years (Required)

License/Certification:





CompTIA (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

description:
Read the whole post before you apply. This is not a call-center gig, and it's not for someone who needs to be told what to do every day. If you already know — not hope, know — that you can pick something up, execute it well without hand-holding, and figure out the rest as you go, keep reading.



About the Role



UFA is a Real Estate Investing / Wholesaling business based in New Jersey. We're hiring one person into a role that starts as a hands-on Acquisitions Caller and is designed to grow into an Acquisitions Manager — someone who eventually helps run the calling side of the business and manages teammates we add under them.



We are not hiring a manager on day one. We're hiring someone who will personally do the work — calling, qualifying, and closing motivated sellers — and prove, in real numbers, that they can be trusted to run more than just their own desk. If you do that, the title, the pay, and the team you lead all grow with you.



The First 30-90 Days — This Is the Hard Part



Early on, this is on you. You'll take direction, learn the property types and the offer logic, and execute the daily calling and qualification work described below — largely on your own, without someone checking in on every step. We'll set the direction and the standards; how you hit them day to day is on you.



Once you've proven you can run this without being managed line by line, this role opens up: you'll help build out and lead the team — starting with the next hire we bring on.



What You'll Personally Own (Day-to-Day Work)



- Call new leads and return inbound calls

- Follow up with previous prospects on a set cadence

- Send compliant texts where appropriate

- Ask seller qualification questions and record motivation, timeline, price expectations, and property condition

- Determine whether a mortgage exists and approximate balance owed

- Determine occupancy and identify any foreclosure/auction deadlines

- Schedule callbacks and categorize leads by motivation level

- Immediately escalate hot sellers so we can move fast

- Update the CRM after every single conversation



The 10 Questions You'll Be Asking Every Seller



1) Why are you considering selling? 2) What condition is the property in? 3) Is anyone currently living there? 4) How quickly would you like to sell? 5) What are you hoping to get for it? 6) Is there currently a mortgage? 7) Approximately what is owed? 8) Are there liens/taxes/other known balances? 9) If we could solve the problem, what would you need to move forward? 10) Who else needs to approve the sale?



Hours & Schedule



Hours: 5 hours/day, 4 days/week (20 hrs/week) to start

Calling window: Primarily U.S. Eastern Time



Daily Targets



60-100 outbound call attempts/day, aiming for 15+ actual owner contacts, 5+ meaningful conversations, 2+ potentially motivated sellers, and 1+ qualified lead.



What We're Looking For



- Excellent, natural conversational English — this is non-negotiable

- Previous experience cold calling U.S. sellers, ideally in real estate

- Comfortable discussing distressed property situations with empathy and respect

- Thick skin — able to handle rejection and stay consistent

- Doesn't sound scripted or robotic on the phone

- Strong, disciplined follow-up habits

- CRM experience (any major CRM)

- Able to recognize genuine motivation vs. a lead that's going nowhere

- Sticks to authorized talking points — does not negotiate outside approved boundaries

- Genuinely wants to manage and build a team eventually — not just work a shift

- Comfortable with ambiguity in the first 90 days, and can take a direction and run with it without needing every step spelled out



Compensation — Built to Reward Ownership, Not Just Hours



Base pay: $6/hour, 5 hours/day, 4 days/week (20 hrs/week) to start. This is intentional: the real upside here is performance-based, not the hourly rate.

Manager commission: 5% commission on all closed deals, as the acquisitions manager — ongoing, not a one-time bonus.

60-day contract bonus: Additional 5% bonus if you get any deal to a signed contract within your first 60 days. The contract does not need to close within that 60-day window — it just needs to be signed.

90-day growth trigger: If our first deal closes within your first 90 days, your base pay is boosted and we bring on the next hire — your first teammate — with you starting to help lead them.



In short: the faster and better you perform, the faster your pay grows and the faster you're managing people instead of just making calls.



How to Apply



Please include:

- A short voice or video intro (even 60 seconds) so we can hear your spoken English

- Your experience cold calling U.S. homeowners or sellers

- Which CRMs and dialers you've used

- Your available hours (must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time calling windows)

- One example of a time you were given a goal with little instruction and figured out how to hit it on your own

- The word "OWNERSHIP" at the top of your application, so we know you read the full post



Finalists will complete a live seller role-play as part of the interview.

mbers can locate resources quickly without assistance

* Build a strong pipeline of interested creators

* Recruit 50–60+ qualified creators per month

Compensation

Competitive full-time salary + performance bonuses.



You’ll have the opportunity to earn additional bonuses based on the number and quality of creators you recruit with additional rewards when creators you discover go on to produce winning advertising content.



Why Join Us?



We’re building a large-scale creative production system designed to work with hundreds and eventually thousands of creators.



This isn’t a traditional VA position.



You’ll become part of a dedicated creator acquisition team, learn how high-growth ecommerce brands produce and test advertising at scale, and have significant opportunities to progress as the team grows.



How to Apply

title: Accounting, Probate and Estate Administration Paralegal
description:
Legacy Elder Law Center in Leesburg, Virginia is seeking an experienced, highly organized Remote Accounting, Probate Estate Administration Paralegal to join our team. This role is ideal for a paralegal with hands-on probate and estate administration experience who can independently manage the day-to-day details of a probate matter and provide exceptional service to clients navigating the loss of a loved one.



Position Overview

The Remote Accounting, Probate & Estate Administration Paralegal will work closely with our probate and estate administration attorneys, operations manager, and clients throughout all stages of the probate and estate administration process.

This position combines traditional financial and accounting component with probate paralegal responsibilities. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with financial records, bank and investment statements, estate assets and liabilities, transaction histories, reconciliations, and fiduciary accountings.

You will help move matters efficiently from initial qualification and filing through administration, accounting, distribution, and closing by preparing documents, organizing financial information, tracking deadlines, communicating with clients and third parties, and ensuring attorneys have accurate and complete information at every stage of the administration.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, highly detail-oriented, comfortable with numbers, accountable, and capable of taking ownership of assigned matters while working as part of a collaborative remote team.



Key Responsibilities

Accounting, Probate & Estate Administration

• Assist attorneys with probate and estate administration matters from initial filing through final distribution and closing.

• Prepare probate petitions, notices, inventories, accountings, correspondence, and other court and estate administration documents for attorney review.

• Gather and organize information regarding estate assets, liabilities, beneficiaries, creditors, and expenses.

• Communicate regularly and professionally with personal representatives, executors, administrators, beneficiaries, financial institutions, courts, accountants, and other third parties.

• Coordinate the identification, collection, valuation, transfer, liquidation, and distribution of estate assets.

• Assist with obtaining date-of-death values for bank accounts, investment accounts, securities, real estate, business interests, and other estate assets.

• Track court deadlines, filing requirements, creditor periods, inventories, accountings, tax-related deadlines, and other critical dates.

• Prepare and coordinate probate filings and monitor matters for court orders, notices, qualification requirements, and other developments.

• Maintain organized and accurate electronic matter files, ensuring documents, financial records, correspondence, and supporting materials are properly maintained.



Estate Accounting & Financial Responsibilities

A significant part of this position involves assisting with the financial administration and accounting of estates. Candidates should have prior accounting, bookkeeping, financial reconciliation, or similar experience and be comfortable working extensively with financial information.

Responsibilities include:

• Review and organize bank statements, investment statements, canceled checks, deposit records, invoices, receipts, and other financial documents.

• Assist with the preparation of fiduciary and estate accountings showing assets received, income, gains and losses, expenses, distributions, and assets remaining on hand.

• Reconcile estate bank and investment accounts and identify discrepancies or missing transactions.

• Create and maintain detailed spreadsheets tracking estate assets, liabilities, income, expenses, distributions, and other financial activity.

• Trace financial transactions across multiple accounts and statements when necessary.

• Assist with identifying and categorizing estate expenses and disbursements.

• Verify supporting documentation for transactions included in estate accountings.

• Assist with calculating distributions to beneficiaries and confirming that proposed distributions are consistent with attorney instructions and estate documents.

• Track payments to creditors, administrative expenses, professional fees, taxes, and beneficiary distributions.

• Work with executors, administrators, accountants, financial advisors, banks, and other professionals to obtain missing financial records and resolve discrepancies.

• Assist attorneys in preparing financial information and supporting documentation required for inventories, accountings, and other probate filings.

• Maintain clear and organized financial records so that estate transactions can be readily reviewed and verified by the attorney.



Qualifications

• Prior experience as a probate, estate administration, trusts and estates, or similar paralegal is strongly preferred.

• Experience in accounting, bookkeeping, financial administration, or financial reconciliation is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to read and understand bank statements, investment statements, transaction histories, and other financial records.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to create and maintain organized financial spreadsheets.

• Experience reconciling accounts and identifying discrepancies in financial records is highly desirable.

• Experience preparing or assisting with fiduciary, probate, trust, or estate accountings is a significant plus.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to work accurately with numbers and financial data.

• Ability to manage multiple matters, deadlines, and competing priorities with limited supervision.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable communicating professionally with clients, attorneys, courts, financial institutions, accountants, and other professionals.

• Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, and potential issues and proactively bring them to the attorney's attention.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while remaining responsive and accountable to the team.



The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate is someone who enjoys both the legal and financial sides of estate administration. You should be comfortable opening a probate file one moment and reviewing several months of bank statements or reconciling an estate accounting the next.

You do not need to be a CPA, but you should be comfortable working with numbers, understand basic accounting principles, and have the patience and attention to detail necessary to reconstruct and document financial activity accurately.

We value team members who take ownership of their work, communicate when they need assistance, identify problems before they become emergencies, and understand that accuracy is especially important when handling client assets, court filings, and fiduciary accountings.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction describing your accounting, probate and estate administration experience.

In your application, please tell us:

1. Approximately how many years of accounting, probate or estate administration experience you have.

2. Which aspects of an accounting/probate matter you have handled directly.

3. What case-management or legal software you have used.

4. Why you are interested in this position with Legacy Elder Law Center

5. Provide references

6. Please provide a brief voice recording when applying for this position and include the word ACCOUNTING in the subject line.
