title: Client Success Manager (CSM) — Whatsapp Check-Ins for Content Coaching Clients
description:
We run a personal branding community and we need a reliable, warm, detail-obsessed Client Success Manager (CSM) to keep our members and clients feeling supported through consistent check-ins. You'll be logged into one of our team whatsapp accounts and communicating with people on our behalf, following a full SOP and message framework we provide. This is a relationship and consistency role — your job is to make sure no one ever feels forgotten.



You must be genuinely fluent in written English. You'll be messaging our clients directly, in our brand's voice, so your writing needs to feel natural, friendly and professional — not templated or robotic.



This is for a content and personal branding community (EXPERIENCE in the content/personal branding space is NECESSARY)



ROLE 1 — CADENCE CHECK-INS (every 2-3 days):

- At 5:30am Bali time (GMT+8), log in and go through every client one by one

- Open each client's Instagram and check their posting cadence — have they posted in the last 1, 2, or 3 days? What does their overall activity look like?

- Send each client a personalized check-in message based on that cadence, using our SOP and message templates:

   • Posted recently / on track → positive reinforcement and encouragement.

   • Slipping a little (2 days) → a gentle, friendly nudge.

   • Gone quiet (3+ days) → a warmer accountability check-in to re-engage them.

- Personalize each message so it feels human and specific — never copy-paste identical text.

- Log who was messaged and their cadence status in our tracker.



ROLE 2 — WEEKLY REVIEW (every 7 days):

- A larger, more personal check-in with every client.

- Ask how everything's been going, how they're feeling about their content, and what they're currently struggling with — so our team can step in and help.

- Log their responses/struggles in the tracker so nothing slips through.



This role is OUTBOUND CHECK-INS ONLY — you send the scheduled messages and log responses. You do not need to resolve deeper client issues yourself; you flag them to us.



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Have excellent, natural written English (this is non-negotiable — you're client-facing).

- Have experience in a customer success, client care, account management, or community/DM management role.

- Are extremely reliable and consistent — this job lives or dies on showing up every single day at the same time.

- Are reliably available at 5:30am Bali time (GMT+8) every day.

- Are organized and comfortable working from a tracker/SOP without being chased.

- Are warm and personable — clients should feel like they're talking to a real, caring human (sounding like our team founder)

- Have a laptop, stable internet, and can work inside Instagram DMs and Google Sheets.



WHAT YOU GET:

- Full SOPs and message frameworks — no guesswork, everything is documented.

- A steady, long-term role with raises for consistent performance.

- Simple, repeatable daily work once you're trained.

- opportunity for promotion, long time (full time) work and raises



HOW TO APPLY: Start your application with the word "CADENCE" so I know you read this. Include: (1) a short note on any customer success / client care / DM management experience you have, (2) two or three sentences written in your own words welcoming a client and checking in on how their week has gone (so I can see your English and tone), and (3) confirmation that you can reliably work at 5:30am Bali time every day.

title: Scientific Content Editor
description:
About Us:

At MSE Supplies, we power scientific breakthroughs. As a fast-growing supplier of advanced materials, lab equipment, and analytical instruments, we serve innovators in more than 70 countries—helping researchers, engineers, and manufacturers solve tough problems every day.



We’re on a mission to make top-tier scientific tools more accessible, more responsive, and more personal. That starts with providing clear, accurate, and deeply reliable technical knowledge to the global scientific community.



Position Overview:

MSE Supplies LLC is seeking a detail-oriented Scientific Content Editor with a strong STEM background to oversee our technical blog production pipeline. In this role, you will take drafts generated by our AI workflows and custom internal AI tools, then transform them into polished, rigorously fact-checked, and engaging technical articles that resonate with researchers, lab managers, and materials engineers.



You will collaborate closely with our dedicated SEO Specialist—taking their keyword roadmaps and content briefs and bringing them to life with high editorial standards, scientific accuracy, and natural tone. While we build the internal AI tooling and supply the SEO roadmap, you will be the editorial pilot overseeing the process: validating scientific claims, humanizing the prose, and maintaining our content pipeline.



Responsibilities:

⚬ Fact-Check & Validate Scientific Content: Rigorously review AI-generated drafts for scientific accuracy, proper chemical/materials terminology, methodology context, and valid data interpretation.

⚬ Humanize & Polish Drafts: Rewrite and edit content generated by our internal AI tools to eliminate robotic phrasing, improve narrative flow, add authentic lab context, and ensure a credible, authoritative brand voice.

⚬ Oversee Content Operations: Manage the end-to-end editorial pipeline—from running topics through our internal AI generators to final publication—ensuring a consistent cadence and exceptional output quality.

⚬ Light Content Strategy & Ideation: Partner with our SEO Specialist to translate keyword clusters into practical article outlines, educational guides, and product-adjacent topic ideas.

⚬ Process Feedback & Refinement: Provide operational feedback on outputs from our proprietary AI tools to help our technical team refine generation quality over time.

⚬ Product Catalog Integration: Naturally integrate MSE Supplies’ product categories (e.g., advanced ceramics, single crystals, battery materials, and lab equipment) into educational content without sounding overly promotional.

Qualifications and Skills:

⚬ Scientific Background: Degree or professional background in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related STEM field. Must be able to read and accurately interpret academic literature.

⚬ Editorial & Copywriting Excellence: Native-level English writing and editing skills with a sharp ear for voice, tone, and readability. Proven ability to translate complex lab concepts into clear, engaging prose.

⚬ Working AI Literacy: Comfortable using LLMs, AI writing interfaces, and internal automated content systems to oversee and guide production efficiently.

⚬ Editorial Pipeline Management: Experience managing a content calendar, technical blog pipeline, or scientific publication workflow.

⚬ Working SEO Literacy: Familiarity with on-page SEO basics (headers, internal linking, search intent) to execute direction provided by our SEO Specialist.

⚬ Self-Starter: Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable collaborating in a fast-paced, remote environment aligned with US business hours.



What Sets You Apart:

⚬ Prior experience writing, editing, or peer-reviewing for scientific B2B brands, academic journals, or technical trade publications.

⚬ Familiarity with on-page SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console.

⚬ Direct experience testing or providing feedback on internal AI generation workflows or custom LLM tooling.

title: Amadeus Ticketing Agent
description:
Who we are. A fast-moving online travel agency serving US and Israeli clients (Tel Aviv ⇄ New York and Europe). Small team, direct access to the owner, zero bureaucracy. Our best agents become trainers and team leads.



The job. You will live in Amadeus. Build PNRs, price and force-price fares, create TSTs manually when auto-pricing fails, issue tickets and EMDs, attempt reissues, add bags, seats, bassinets, and special meals. You will hunt fares like a pro — Amadeus vs ITA Matrix vs Google Flights vs the airline's own website — and present the best option like you're spending your own money. You will call airlines (EL AL, Wizz Air, Norse, Delta and more) to fix problems: missed flights, goodwill waivers, infant add-ons. You will also cover live chat for our brands and, over time, take client calls.



One metric matters. Our dashboard tracks how many days in a row the owner has NOT had to touch a ticket. You are hired to make that number grow.



Requirements. 2+ years hands-on with native Amadeus cryptic entries (not just a web portal on top of it); strong written English; a quiet home office with backup internet and power; comfort making phone calls in English; obsessive attention to names, dates, and deadlines.



Nice to have. Ticketing/reissue experience (ATC), award-booking experience with miles programs, airline or TMC/BPO background (Amex GBT, CWT, BCD or airline reservations), experience with Israeli or US Orthodox-Jewish clientele. Formal credentials welcome but not required: "Amadeus Reservation and Ticketing Cryptic Certification" or "IATA GDS Fares and Ticketing — Amadeus" — 2+ years of native cryptic work at a TMC or airline BPO counts the same.



To apply please fill out this link

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design

### The role



You're an editor who has fully integrated AI generation into your workflow. Your job: produce ad creatives that blend AI-generated content and traditional editing, at a quality level where clients can't tell, or where the style is the point.



- Own the ideation and scripting: you come up with angles, hooks and scripts yourself. We give you direction and winning angles, not a script to execute

- Generate AI video content in two registers: Realistic (products, humans, environments that pass as real footage) and stylized (3D, animated, Claymation, Pixar-style…)

- Edit AI-generated material into performance ads: hooks, pacing, sound design, captions

- Combine AI footage with real footage (UGC, product shots) seamlessly

- Proven portfolio of AI-generated video work, both realistic and stylized

- Solid editing fundamentals: Premiere/CapCut/After Effects, rhythm, sound, mobile-first formats

title: Creator & Community Manager for global football brand
description:
To be considered apply at the bottom of the job description.



Remote, full-time. Anywhere.



We make football gear — shin pads, grip socks and performance kit — and we sell it worldwide. Over 200,000 people follow us across Instagram and TikTok.



We are building an army of affiliates and creators: hundreds of young footballers filming, posting, and earning from what they sell. Everything for it is already built and nobody has used any of it yet. This is the person who starts it.



The role



You are the main point of contact for every creator and affiliate we work with.



That means outbound — finding young footballers on Instagram and TikTok and reaching out, every day. It means inbound, handling everyone who comes to us. It means getting people signed up, with their product, their link and their code sorted. And it means running our 
 and keeping it somewhere people actually want to be.



The hardest part, and the part the job is really judged on, is keeping people producing. Anyone can sign someone up. A roster that posts for six weeks and goes quiet is a failed programme. So you are watching what comes in, replying to every single clip within 72 hours by name, and knowing who has gone quiet before they have properly gone.



You will also spot the people whose content is working and put them forward to move up. Affiliates earn commission on what they sell. The ones whose footage performs get put on a contract and earn from the ad spend behind it. That ladder is the whole pitch, and you are the one who walks people up it.



What this role is not



It is not a marketing strategy job. The system is designed and built — 
, tracking, sign-up pages, the payout side. You are not being hired to redesign it, you are being hired to run it and grow it. If your instinct on day one is to rebuild the programme rather than fill it, this is the wrong role for you.



Who I am looking for



Someone who genuinely loves football. You will watch several hundred clips a month from teenagers on pitches, and you have to be able to tell a good one from a nice one. That judgement cannot be taught quickly and it is the thing most candidates will not have.



Someone who is ruthless with an inbox. Hundreds of messages, nobody ignored, nothing templated. If you write like a brand rather than a person, creators stop replying and the whole thing dies quietly.



Someone who has run a community before — a 
, a group chat, a roster, anything where people showed up because of you specifically. I care far more about that than about where you have worked.



And someone careful. This role touches what people get paid. A sloppy tag or a wrong name in a spreadsheet means somebody's money is wrong, and that is how you lose trust with a roster you spent months building.



Strong written English matters more here than anywhere else in the company, because almost the entire job is short written messages to strangers.
